name: DecisionAudit
rows: Decision Audit: Review of Internal Claims
"Fixed-bank set changes have removed asset weight effects, so remaining changes can be called bank-specific credit deterioration."

Shapley decomposition shows: within-bank rate change = +0.0582 pp (79%), asset weight (mix) change = +0.0156 pp (21%). Fixed-weight bridge (2024 weights) gives +0.0630 pp, but this holds weights constant at ONE point in time. The symmetric decomposition reveals weight effects still contributed 21% of the common-set change.
Review procedures must examine BOTH loan quality deterioration AND portfolio composition shifts. Cannot attribute entire change to "credit deterioration."
"13 person-days is sufficient for 8 basic reviews plus 3 full reviews (one per state)."

8 basic reviews × 1 day = 8 days. 3 full reviews × (1+2) days = 9 days. Total = 14 days, not 13. The claim appears to count full reviews as 2 days total instead of 3 days total (1 basic + 2 additional).
Committee must approve 14 person-days to meet all requirements. Current 13-day budget is insufficient. Optimal allocation requires 14 days.
